title: SEO audit: service pages
headline: Service pages are sound; two titles are cut off in search and FAQ markup is missing.
body:
## What I checked
Eight service pages and the home page: title, meta description, canonical, headings, structured data, alt text and internal links.

## Findings
- The plant maintenance and billing pages have titles longer than search shows; both are cut mid-phrase.
- No page carries FAQ structured data, though three answer common questions.
- The home page does not link to either case page.

## Not a problem
Canonicals, language tags and headings are correct everywhere.

actions.title: Shorten two service page titles
actions.detail: Plant maintenance: 'SAP plant maintenance for operators | Larkwell'. Billing: 'SAP utilities billing support | Larkwell'.
actions.why: Both are cut off in search results.

actions.title: Add FAQ markup to three service pages
actions.detail: Mark up the existing question-and-answer sections on plant maintenance, billing and S/4HANA.
actions.why: Eligible for richer results at no content cost.

title: Plan for the week of 2026-11-16
headline: Field service for operators: own the SAP side of crews, work orders and tablets.
body:
**Focus:** Field service for operators: own the SAP side of crews, work orders and tablets.

## Themes
- **Work orders closed at the asset** (plant-maintenance): High-intent searches with weak SAP-specific answers.
- **Billing exceptions by cause** (billing): Small but high-intent queries; no competitor answers them well.

## Pieces to write
1. Blog on "sap pm mobile work orders" (plant-maintenance): Closing work orders at the asset with a three-screen tablet app *Why: Closest gap to page one*
2. Blog on "sap is-u billing exceptions" (billing): Measure exceptions by cause, fix the top two, then automate *Why: No competitor covers it*
3. LinkedIn how-to (plant-maintenance): The Friday keying problem and the three-screen fix *Why: Supports the work orders blog*
4. LinkedIn how-to (basis): Patch day: rate notes against your own landscape *Why: Monthly patch-day slot*
5. LinkedIn hot-take (fiori): Offline mode matters more than any feature for depot tablets *Why: Differentiates from mobility vendors*

## Leave alone this week
- Clean core debates
- Generic transformation framing
- Another S/4HANA deadline post

## Questions for the Researcher
- Preventive maintenance for bin lorries in SAP PM (Waste operators are an open gap)

## Notes
Keep the Brackenfield case for a single post this week; it is the strongest proof we have.
